text:
emma: Kicking off a CONFIG-ONLY rollout for routing weights + batching defaults. Change window 21:00-22:00 PT. No model or code changes, just service config. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m holds. Dash: https://dash.local/config-preflight

deploy-bot: job queued: job=cfg-rollout-7943123456 (config-only). Applying canary to 5% now.

raj: Thanks. Quick checklist: rollback steps, metrics to watch, and owner?

emma: Owner: emma. Rollback: two options - 
```
# quick rollback to previous config snapshot
redwoodctl config rollback --snapshot cfg-snap-20260320-02 --target routing,batching
# or ask deploy-bot to revert job
deploy-bot: /rollback cfg-rollout-7943123456
```
Also put a sticky unpin on consumer routing if anything weird shows.

leah: Watching KV cache hitrate, 95p latency, and tail CPU on worker pool. Set alerts: latency > 180ms or error-rate > 0.8% -> escalate.

mike: Are we pinning model versions for the slow-path? Config-only but want to ensure fallback stable.

emma: No model version changes. If fallback triggers we'll route to the preexisting stable variant (ver-20260210). Not changing weights for that variant.

obs-bot: smoke checks OK at t+5m: 95p latency delta +6ms, error-rate unchanged.

deploy-bot: canary applied to 5% (tenants: general, staging mirrored). Holding 15m. Next step will be 25% if no rollbacks. job=cfg-rollout-7943123456

raj: If we see sustained +25ms p95 or any spike in 5xxs, we rollback immediately. Also please grab sample traces for any slow traces (span ids in tracing).

emma: Will capture a 10-minute perf snapshot during the hold and post it here. If conditions met: /rollback + notify oncall.

leah: Quick note — metric to watch: routing.kv_miss_rate and batch.window_size_avg. If kv_miss_rate > 2% we will suspect TTL blowout.

emma: Snapshot in thread: https://s3.local/cfg-rollout-7943123456/snapshot.json (includes diff of routing.weights and batching.window_ms).

deploy-bot: progressing: canary -> 25% (completed). Hold initiated. Next hold 20m.

mike: Observability sanity looks good from my side — no backend 5xx, p95 within threshold.

obs-bot: telemetry: p95 +8ms, cpu +3%, kv_miss +0.6%.

raj: good. If any tenant shows >200ms p95 or error-rate >1% we stop. Otherwise proceed to 100% per plan.

emma: Acknowledged. If rollback, I will run the rollback command above and notify infra. Logging the rollback playbook snippet here for quick copy: 
```
# rollback sequence
deploy-bot: /pause cfg-rollout-7943123456
redwoodctl config apply --from-snapshot cfg-snap-20260320-02 --services routing,batching
# verify smoke, then unpause traffic if stable
```

leah: tagging @oncall for extra eyes during the final ramp.

emma: Final note — release notes will say: "Config-only: adjusted routing weights and batching window defaults to reduce slow-path tail latency; staged canary with rollback safepoints." We will publish post-mortem if we had to rollback.

deploy-bot: job completed: cfg-rollout-7943123456 -> 100% traffic at 21:42 PT. No automatic rollbacks.

emma: Thanks team — leaving monitors for another 30m then closing out.

raj: Thanks, great coordination.
